title: AI Bubble Fears Are Creating New Derivatives
title_zh: 人工智能泡沫恐惧正在创造新的衍生品
summary: Credit derivatives tied to single companies didn’t exist on many high-grade Big Tech issuers a year ago, and are now some of the most actively traded US contracts in the market outside of the financial sector, according to Depository Trust & Clearing Corp.
summary_zh: 根据存款信托与清算公司的数据，一年前，许多高级大型科技发行人并不存在与单一公司挂钩的信用衍生品，但现在它们已成为金融领域以外市场上交易最活跃的美国合约之一。

title: S&P 500 ends up slightly as tech dips, inflation cools
title_zh: 随着科技股下跌、通胀降温，标普 500 指数小幅收涨

title: Trump's potential steel, aluminum rollback would be latest tariff reversal amid broader affordability push
title_zh: 特朗普可能取消钢铁和铝关税，这将是在更广泛的负担能力推动下最新的关税逆转
summary: A move to simplify tariffs on metals would be the latest of about half a dozen changes in Trump's tariff policy in recent months.
summary_zh: 简化金属关税的举措将是特朗普近几个月关税政策的六项变化中的最新一项。

title: Big Tech's data center push has sent electricity bills higher. Lawmakers want to slow them down.
title_zh: 大型科技公司的数据中心建设导致电费上涨。立法者希望减缓他们的速度。
summary: As Big Tech has surged ahead with a mass data center build-out, state congressional leaders have begun introducing bills that would pause developments in their states.
summary_zh: 随着大型科技公司大规模扩建数据中心，各州国会领导人已开始提出暂停本州开发的法案。

title: Retirement investors go global
summary: Retirement investors are turning their attention overseas and putting more money into international stocks and emerging markets, according to a new report.
summary_zh: 一份新报告显示，退休投资者正在将注意力转向海外，并将更多资金投入国际股票和新兴市场。
